description: Every issue of one large validate_bundle result, a page at a time. Give it the result_id from a validate_bundle summary; it reads what validate_bundle kept (the findings, never the bundle) for 1 hour, so the bundle is not sent again and the validator does not run again. The issues come in the order POST /api/v1/validate returns them; call again with page.next_offset until it is null. Optional severity filters to fatal, error, warning or information. An unknown or expired result_id is an error: run validate_bundle again. Synthetic payloads only. Never send real patient data. Findings describe a synthetic Bundle. 60 calls per minute; MCP only.

offset.description: Where the page starts, counting the issues chosen (default 0); use page.next_offset.

result_id.description: From a validate_bundle summary (result_id or next_steps).
